definitions.explanation: Hair that grows on the human body, excluding head hair and facial hair. Includes arm hair, leg hair, chest hair, etc.

examples.japanese: {体毛|たいもう}の{処理|しょり}にはいろいろな{方法|ほうほう}がある。
examples.english: There are various methods for removing body hair.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}の{体毛|たいもう}は{進化|しんか}の{過程|かてい}で{薄|うす}くなったと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that human body hair became thinner in the process of evolution.

notes:
Composed of {体|たい} (body) and {毛|もう} (hair, fur). A neutral, slightly formal term. In everyday conversation, people more often refer to specific types of body hair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体毛|たいもう}が{濃|こ}い: to have thick/dense body hair
- {体毛|たいもう}が{薄|うす}い: to have thin/sparse body hair
- {体毛|たいもう}の{処理|しょり}: body hair removal
- {体毛|たいもう}を{剃|そ}る: to shave body hair

RELATED TERMS:
- {髪|かみ}の{毛|け}: head hair
- {毛|け}: hair (general, native Japanese word)
- むだ{毛|げ}: unwanted hair — the term commonly used in beauty/grooming contexts
- {脱毛|だつもう}: hair removal, depilation
